basic_info.description: *5% down and financing incentives available* Built in 1932, this home has stood the test of time with vintage detail, solid bones, and a touch of old Hollywood glamour. The show starts at the entry level with inlaid hardwood floors and stairway waiting for your grand entrance. Upstairs, the drama continues with two front bedrooms, each framed by triple arched windows and more gleaming, inlaid floors. But the show-stopper is at the back where a wide-open kitchen/dining that gives way to a deck with cinematic Southern views. Morning coffee on here will feel like the first shot of a classic film, and your evening glass the final scene of a story well told.  Back down at the entry level are two ample bedrooms and two baths ready for you to stretch out and enjoy privacy and quiet. One is a principal suite opening onto another back deck. One level below, a 700-square foot bonus space opening directly onto the back yard is ready for the big game, your ultimate playroom or dreamy home studio.   The 1300 block of Palou is on a gentle up slope. Two blocks down, the 3rd Street light rail is at your disposal for the upcoming Dua Lipa and Billie Eilish concerts and the 15 Express Bus across the street will take you straight to downtown. You also have swift access to the 101 or 280.
